# Copilot Instructions

## General recommendations
- If the user asks to create a commit, always create a commit in English with actual changes and file indexing (not an empty commit).
- All keys and passwords in the settings are fake; the real ones are on the device. Do not check these errors.
- Always keep a log of our conversation in this folder so that the context is not lost when moving to a new environment. And restore it when opening a new chat.
- All texts on the web page are in English.
